info.description: T-003 contract; T-080–T-082 job titles/permissions; T-083–T-086 overview/docs/files/batch; T-088 workload/project overview; T-089 preferences; T-090 favorites; owner 2026-10-09 group order, project metadata and team/member contact details; group-order history response correction; owner checklist inline editing and remark. Baseline1.1 + owner-approved RD01–08; Node22/SQLite local, SQL2022 target. Schemas are not authorization or transaction implementation.
